description: Defines classes and types for I-RNTI (Radio Network Temporary Identifier) used in 3GPP specifications, including Full-I-RNTI and Short-I-RNTI, with methods for creation, comparison, and formatting.

classes.name: full_i_rnti_t
classes.description: Represents a 40-bit Full-I-RNTI with methods for creation from components or integer representation, comparison operators, and value retrieval.

classes.name: short_i_rnti_t
classes.description: Represents a 20-bit Short-I-RNTI with similar methods as full_i_rnti_t.

methods.name: full_i_rnti_t
methods.description: Constructor to create a Full-I-RNTI from gNB ID, UE ID, and number of UE bits.

methods.name: full_i_rnti_t::max
methods.description: Returns the maximum possible Full-I-RNTI value.

methods.name: full_i_rnti_t::min
methods.description: Returns the minimum possible Full-I-RNTI value.

methods.name: full_i_rnti_t::from_uint
methods.description: Creates a Full-I-RNTI from a uint64_t value, validating range.

methods.name: full_i_rnti_t::value
methods.description: Returns the uint64_t value of the Full-I-RNTI.

methods.name: short_i_rnti_t
methods.description: Constructor to create a Short-I-RNTI from gNB ID, UE ID, and number of UE bits.

methods.name: short_i_rnti_t::from_uint
methods.description: Creates a Short-I-RNTI from a uint32_t value, validating range.

methods.name: short_i_rnti_t::value
methods.description: Returns the uint32_t value of the Short-I-RNTI.
